page.notes: Running head is the title only; "Cap 6" at the top right is a chapter marker and is left out. The page number 254 is at the head left. Doubtful readings: "Ba-silicis" in note c, "pra-" at the page end (may continue as "prae-"), "H.E." in note y. The mark for note g is not clearly visible in the text; it is placed before "legibus" by position. The note "Matth.10.38." carries the same mark f as the earlier note at "Christum"; the printed sign may differ. The mark at "Si Censum" is printed as a dot-like sign, read as e. Italic boundaries in paragraphs I and III are approximate. The text ends mid-sentence, so the page continues.
